intro.h2: Kitchen Remodeling Without the Long Wait
paragraphs: Ortega Remodeling handles kitchen remodeling from cabinets to countertops, and its customers keep mentioning speed. One customer was skeptical about a large project on a short timeline, yet Fernando Ortega and his team remodeled the kitchen in two weeks flat, at a very reasonable price compared with other estimates.

Brenda J. says the team was patient while she picked her countertop, then installed it in one day. Denise M. has had almost a whole house done: new flooring, interior painting, a kitchen makeover, an upgraded bathroom and a full room addition. Customers come back for the next project, from room conversions to bathrooms.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen makeovers with new cabinets, counters, backsplash and flooring. The kitchen shown has white shaker cabinets, a marble-look waterfall island with an undermount sink, a mosaic backsplash and wood-look plank floors. One reviewer's kitchen was remodeled in two weeks flat.

items.name: Countertop installation
items.blurb: Help choosing the right countertop, then a quick install. Brenda J. says the team was patient while she picked her countertop, and installation was done in one day. The photo shows white quartz with a matching full backsplash around a gas cooktop.

image.alt: White quartz countertop and full backsplash around a stainless gas cooktop above dark wood cabinets and a wall oven

items.name: Bathroom remodeling

items.name: Flooring and interior painting
items.blurb: New flooring and interior paint, room by room or through the whole house. Denise M. had both done as part of a top-to-bottom transformation, along with her kitchen and bathroom, and called every project handled with care and professionalism.

items.blurb: Extra space when the house no longer fits. Denise M. had a full room addition built, and another customer was getting ready for a room conversion with the team after her kitchen. Call to talk through what you want the new room to do.

about.h2: Meet Fernando Ortega and the Team
about.text: Ortega Remodeling is led by Fernando Ortega, and the logo carries the full name, Ortega Remodeling and Services Inc. The team takes on kitchens, bathrooms, countertops, flooring, interior painting and room additions, and shares its projects with more than 1,400 followers on Instagram. Customers describe the crew as friendly, dependable and committed to quality work, and say every project was handled with care and professionalism. Several have already lined up their next job with the team, from a room conversion to more work around the house.

image.alt: Ortega Remodeling and Services Inc logo in gold and silver with a house roofline on black

process.h2: How a Remodel With Ortega Works

steps.title: Call
steps.text: Call (562) 618-3424 Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM or Saturday 9 AM to 2 PM to describe your project.

steps.title: Estimate
steps.text: The team looks at the space and gives you an estimate. Reviewers found the price reasonable compared with other estimates.

steps.title: Choose materials
steps.text: Pick cabinets, counters, tile and flooring at your own pace. The team stays patient while you decide, as a reviewer noted.

steps.title: Build on schedule
steps.text: Work is done on the agreed timeline, whether a one-day countertop install or a full kitchen in two weeks.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: You walk through the finished room together and make sure every detail is right before the job is closed.

service_area.text: Ortega Remodeling has not published a street address or a list of service towns on Google, so the quickest way to check is to call (562) 618-3424 and give your address. The team is open Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 2 PM. Tell them about the room you want to change and when you hope to start.

items.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the kitchen and the materials you choose. As one example, a reviewer had her kitchen remodeled in two weeks flat and said the team delivered as promised. Countertop installation alone was done in one day for another customer. You will get a timeline with your estimate.

Kitchen remodeling, countertop installation, bathroom remodeling, new flooring, interior painting, room additions and room conversions. Reviewers have had everything from a single countertop to a home transformed from top to bottom. If your project is not on this list, call and describe it to see whether it fits.

items.q: Can you help me choose a countertop?
items.a: Yes. One customer says the team was patient with her while she picked her countertop, and the installation was done in one day. Bring photos of styles you like, and ask about colours and edges when the team comes out to look at your kitchen and measure for the new top.

Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 2 PM. The office is closed on Sunday. Call (562) 618-3424 during those hours, or leave a message with your name, number and project and the team will call you back to set up a visit.

Prices depend on the project and are not published, but one reviewer who collected several estimates says Ortega Remodeling came in at a very reasonable price compared with the others, and still finished a large kitchen on a short timeline. Ask for a written estimate to compare.

final_cta.text: Call Fernando and the team about your kitchen remodeling, bathroom or room addition.
